name: D-spray Biyaku de Motemote Kachou Dairi Hosa
original_name: D-spray 媚薬でモテモテ 課長代理補佐
source: The protagonist has been working at a job for several years but can't seem to rise through ranks anymore. With no respect from most of employee and rumors of restructure going on he is sick of his job. However, one day he is called in by research department to test out experimental pheromone drug. After the testing, the drug turns out to be real deal and he starts to target women that he works with, making his job more interesting.
translation: 主角已經工作了好幾年，卻怎麼也等不到升遷。大多數員工都不尊重他，公司裡還流傳著組織改造的風聲，他早已受夠了這份工作。然而有一天，研究部門找他測試一種實驗性費洛蒙藥物。測試結束後，藥物被證明確實有效，他開始對女同事下手，讓乏味的工作變得有趣起來。
